data.name: Jigyasa
data.gender_notes: Jigyasa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jigyasa is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jignasu’, which means ‘to inquire’ or ‘to seek knowledge’. In Hindu mythology, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom is Saraswati, and Jigyasa can be seen as an embodiment of her curious and inquisitive nature. The name Jigyasa carries the meaning “Inquisitive, Curious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jigyasa usually hope their child will grow to embody inquisitive, curious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your life be filled with a thirst for knowledge and a deep sense of curiosity.
data.etymology: Jigyasa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Inquisitive, Curious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jigyasa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
